cases.question: How many orders are there?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

cases.question: What is the average revenue per order?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(order_revenue) AS average_order_revenue FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(revenue) AS order_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

cases.question: How many product units were sold in total?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items

cases.question: How many orders are in each region? Return the region name and order count.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT regions.name AS region_name, COUNT(orders.order_id) AS order_count FROM regions JOIN orders USING (region_id) GROUP BY regions.name

cases.question: What is the total revenue for each product category? Return the category name and revenue.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT categories.name AS category_name, SUM(order_items.revenue) AS revenue FROM categories JOIN products USING (category_id) JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY categories.name

cases.question: What is the gross profit for each product? Return the product name and gross profit.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT products.name AS product_name, SUM(order_items.revenue - order_items.cost) AS gross_profit FROM products JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY products.name

cases.question: What was total revenue in the first quarter of 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.revenue) AS revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items USING (order_id) WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-04-01'

cases.question: What was total revenue in the second quarter of 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.revenue) AS revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items USING (order_id) WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

cases.question: How many orders were placed from April 15, 2026 through April 30, 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-15' AND order_date < DATE '2026-05-01'

cases.question: Which product categories have negative total gross profit? Return the category name and gross profit.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT categories.name AS category_name, SUM(order_items.revenue - order_items.cost) AS gross_profit FROM categories JOIN products USING (category_id) JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY categories.name HAVING SUM(order_items.revenue - order_items.cost) < 0

cases.question: Which regions have at least two orders? Return the region name and order count.

cases.question: Which products sold at least three units? Return the product name and total units.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT products.name AS product_name, SUM(order_items.quantity) AS total_units FROM products JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY products.name HAVING SUM(order_items.quantity) >= 3

cases.question: Which products have total revenue above the average product revenue? Return the product name and revenue.
cases.expected_sql: WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT products.name AS product_name, SUM(order_items.revenue) AS revenue FROM products JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY products.name) SELECT product_name, revenue FROM product_revenue WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM product_revenue)

cases.question: Which products are tied for the highest total revenue? Return every tied product name and its revenue.
cases.expected_sql: WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT products.name AS product_name, SUM(order_items.revenue) AS revenue FROM products JOIN order_items USING (product_id) GROUP BY products.name) SELECT product_name, revenue FROM product_revenue WHERE revenue = (SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM product_revenue)
